title: Battle of Musa Dagh
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Musa Dagh Resistance", at revision 1370628972, opens: "Musa Dagh is a mountain in the Hatay Province of Turkey. In 1915, it was the location of a successful Armenian resistance to the Armenian genocide, an event that inspired Franz Werfel to write the novel The Forty Days of Musa Dagh." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q19831524, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Armenian resistance during the Armenian genocide". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
